author: Umbhali: Okuwukuphela kweGuru yezinkolo ezintathu (amaHindu, amaSulumane, amaKrestu), iNkosi yoMbuso Kamoya, uMlobi wezincwadi ezingcwele ezingaphezu kwekhulu, u-Indu Gnana Dharma Pradata, uMlobi Wokuthakazelisa, u-Adi Karta we-Thraitha Teachings, uSri Sri Acharya Prabodhananda Yogeeswarulu
titles: Okuwukuphela kweGuru yezinkolo ezintathu (amaHindu, amaSulumane, amaKrestu), iNkosi yoMbuso Kamoya, uMlobi wezincwadi ezingcwele ezingaphezu kwekhulu, u-Indu Gnana Dharma Pradata, uMlobi Wokuthakazelisa, u-Adi Karta we-Thraitha

image5.1: Ama-adharma amane athatha amaphesenti ayishumi abantu, kuyilapho inkolo ithatha amaphesenti angama-99
image5.2: Nakuba i-Yagna, i-Dana (umnikelo), i-Veda, ne-Tapas (ukuzindla isikhathi eside) kuyi-adharmas emine, i-adharma yesihlanu inkolo.
image5.5: Uma nisenkolweni endleleni yasemhlabeni, nizobulawa endleleni kaNkulunkulu.
image5.7: Inkolo iyi-adharma yesihlanu ukuvela eKali Yuga esanda kuphuma.

image6.1: Izinkolo zivinjelwe futhi zivinjelwe. Ama-castes awanangqondo futhi awahambisani nesayensi.
image6.3: zonke izingxenye ezintathu zombhalo ofanayo waphezulu. Uma isimo sakho sengqondo sidlulela ngale kwe-caste nenkolo, joyina ngokushesha
image6.7: Sri Sri Sri Acharya Prabodhananda Yogeeshwarulu
